map.Hex 每个字节用 2 个字符、体积翻倍，但天然可读、便于人眼比对与定位偏移，适: Hex spends 2 characters per byte, doubling the size, but is naturally readable and easy to compare by eye while pinning down offsets — ideal for debugging, packet captures and memory dumps. Base64 turns every 3 bytes into 4 characters, inflating by about 33%, which suits transport and storage. Use hex when a human needs to read it, Base64 when you need to save space.
